name: Teradyne

eyebrow.en: Teradyne, Inc. · Common stock · North Reading, Massachusetts
eyebrow.zh: 泰瑞达 · 普通股 · 马萨诸塞州北雷丁

title.en: The test every AI chip must pass, now twice the business it was a year ago.
title.zh: 每颗 AI 芯片必经的测试关卡，业务规模一年翻倍。

lede.en: Teradyne makes the machines that test chips before they ship, plus Universal Robots cobots and MiR mobile robots. AI demand doubled revenue to a record $1.33B last quarter: compute test grew nearly sixfold and memory test hit a record on HBM and DRAM. The catch is lumpiness and price: Q3 guidance of $1.20–1.30B is a step down, and the stock trades at about 55 times trailing earnings.
lede.zh: 泰瑞达生产芯片出厂前所用的测试设备，另有 Universal Robots 协作机器人和 MiR 移动机器人。AI 需求使上季营收翻倍至创纪录的 13.3 亿美元：计算类测试增长近六倍，存储测试在 HBM 和 DRAM 带动下创新高。问题在于订单波动与估值：Q3 指引 12–13 亿美元，环比回落，股价约为过去四季盈利的 55 倍。

s.zh: GAAP 每股 $7.29 · 按 2026 年调整后每股一致预期 $9.11 约 44 倍

s.en: Q3 2026 and Q4 guide · date not yet announced
s.zh: 2026 第三季及 Q4 指引 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Teradyne has roughly doubled this year, but has swung between about $320 and $484 since June.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。泰瑞达今年股价约翻倍，但自6月以来收盘价在约 $320 至 $484 之间大幅波动。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Teradyne's fiscal year is the calendar year (quarters end on the Sunday nearest the month end). Revenue sat near $600–750M a quarter from 2023 to 2025, then jumped on AI test demand. The last bar is the $1.25B midpoint of Q3 2026 guidance.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。泰瑞达财年与日历年一致（季度结束于最接近月末的周日）。2023 至 2025 年季度营收约在 6–7.5 亿美元，之后因 AI 测试需求跃升。最后一根柱为 2026 年 Q3 指引中值 12.5 亿美元。

s.zh: 同比 +104% · 环比 +4% · 创纪录
同比 +128% · SoC 8.43 亿，其中计算约占 70%
创纪录 · HBM、DRAM、NAND · 订单出货比 >2
同比 +26% · 电路板与光学测试

p.en: Compute revenue grew nearly 600% from a year ago and AI drove over 60% of sales. Teradyne qualified a second AI hyperscaler and shipped a merchant GPU order.
p.zh: 计算类营收同比增长近 600%，AI 相关占销售六成以上。泰瑞达已完成第二家 AI 超大规模客户的验证，并交付一笔商用 GPU 订单。

p.en: Memory test hit a record $212M, its third quarter above $200M, with orders over twice shipments. Management sees the 2026 memory test market more than 40% larger than 2025.
p.zh: 存储测试创下 2.12 亿美元纪录，连续第三季超过 2 亿，订单为出货两倍以上。管理层预计 2026 年存储测试市场较 2025 年扩大逾 40%。

h.zh: Q3 财报与 Q4 指引

p.en: The Q3 guide of $1.20–1.30B is below Q2's $1.33B on compute order timing and soft mobile. The market will look for Q4 guidance to show growth resuming.
p.zh: 因计算订单时点与手机疲软，Q3 指引 12–13 亿美元低于 Q2 的 13.3 亿。市场将关注 Q4 指引能否重回增长。

p.en: After a 2025 restructuring that cut about 150 jobs, Robotics grew 33% to $100M. A U.S. factory is due to open later this year, and a cobot dispute with Elite Robots was settled in October.
p.zh: 经过 2025 年裁员约 150 人的重组，机器人营收增长 33% 至 1 亿美元。美国工厂预计今年稍后投产，与 Elite Robots 的协作机器人纠纷已于10月和解。

p.en: Test spending moves in big, uneven waves tied to a few chip makers. Revenue fell from $951M in Q3 2021 to $600M in Q1 2024 in the last downturn.
p.zh: 测试设备支出集中于少数芯片厂，波动大且不均。上一轮下行中，营收由 2021 年 Q3 的 9.51 亿美元降至 2024 年 Q1 的 6.0 亿。

p.en: At about 55 times trailing GAAP earnings, the stock prices in more growth. It fell 34% from its Jun 30 record close to Jul 29 before rebounding.
p.zh: 按过去四季 GAAP 盈利计约 55 倍，股价已反映更多增长。股价曾由 6月30日收盘纪录跌至 7月29日，跌幅 34%，之后反弹。

p.en: Guidance is $1.20–1.30B of revenue and $1.85–2.15 adjusted EPS. Date not yet announced.
p.zh: 指引为营收 12–13 亿美元、调整后每股 $1.85–2.15。日期未公布。

p.en: Management said its U.S. manufacturing center for Robotics is on track to open later this year.
p.zh: 管理层表示机器人业务的美国制造中心按计划于今年稍后启用。

p.en: Full-year 2026 results and the first read on 2027, which management expects to be another growth year.
p.zh: 2026 全年业绩及对 2027 年的首次展望，管理层预计 2027 年继续增长。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Teradyne, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Teradyne, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Teradyne's fiscal year is the calendar year. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年 Q3 至 2026 年 Q2 共 20 个季度。泰瑞达财年与日历年一致。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年6月28日 · 另有 1.62 亿长期证券 · 循环贷款已还清

read.en: Teradyne's free cash flow is lumpy and often weakest in the first quarter: it was negative in Q1 2022, Q1 2023 and Q1 2024. The AI ramp changed the scale. Q2 2026 produced $378M, the best quarter since 2021, and the last four quarters add up to about $800M, even though Q3 2025 was only $2M as inventory built.
read.zh: 泰瑞达自由现金流波动大，第一季常为最弱：2022、2023 和 2024 年 Q1 均为负。AI 放量改变了规模。2026 年 Q2 自由现金流 3.78 亿美元，为 2021 年以来最佳，近四季合计约 8 亿，尽管 2025 年 Q3 因备货仅 200 万。

read.en: My base case uses the $1.25B Q3 guide midpoint, a similar level in Q4 and into 2027, with capex near $85–90M a quarter as the company adds capacity. That gives about $1.15B over four quarters. The main risk is order timing: a pause in compute or memory orders would cut revenue and cash quickly, as in 2023–24.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用 Q3 指引中值 12.5 亿美元，Q4 及 2027 年初维持相近水平，资本开支随扩产保持每季约 8,500 万–9,000 万美元，四季合计约 11.5 亿美元。主要风险是订单时点：计算或存储订单一旦暂停，营收与现金会迅速下滑，如 2023–24 年。

p.zh: 每股 $0.13，每季约 2,000 万美元。

p.en: $702M bought back in 2025, but only $74M in the first half of 2026.
p.zh: 2025 年回购 7.02 亿美元，但 2026 年上半年仅 7,400 万。

p.en: Capex rose to $91M in Q2. Teradyne bought TestInsight in April and invested in Bright Machines in October.
p.zh: Q2 资本开支升至 9,100 万美元。泰瑞达4月收购 TestInsight，10月投资 Bright Machines。

p.en: Semiconductor Test revenue topped $1B for two quarters in a row.
p.zh: 半导体测试营收连续两季超过 10 亿美元。

p.en: Memory book-to-bill above 2 points to more shipments in the second half.
p.zh: 存储订单出货比高于 2，预示下半年出货增加。

p.en: Robotics sales grew 33% after the 2025 cost cuts.
p.zh: 2025 年削减成本后，机器人销售增长 33%。

bridgeNote.en: Teradyne has almost no debt. Buybacks slowed in 2026 while it spent on capacity and deals, so cash could build if that pace holds; acquisitions are not in this bridge.
bridgeNote.zh: 泰瑞达几乎无负债。2026 年回购放缓，资金用于扩产与并购，若此节奏持续，现金可能累积；本测算未计入并购。
